usedFor: ThriveCart holds your subscriptions and Google Meet holds your calls, so “Subscription Rebill Cancelled” can run “Schedule a Meeting”.

bestTemplate.name: “Subscription Rebill Cancelled” in ThriveCart, then “Schedule a Meeting” in Google Meet
bestTemplate.why: A cancelled rebill books a Google Meet call, so you can talk to the customer before they are gone.

watchOut: “Add People to Google Meet” invites people outside the business, so that invite waits in Needs you for approval.
